original.target_description: Overall Mantel–Haenszel odds ratio of publication of statistically significant versus nonsignificant dissertation outcomes; education broadly, not restricted to special education.

n.sample_role: dissertation–published paper matched pairs (strata); 1,599 treatment outcomes nested within these studies
n.exclusions: Included matched studies meeting intervention/outcome/testing criteria; no additional exclusions for the overall odds ratio identified.
n.location: OnlineFirst p. 5, Results and Table 2 note
n.quote: Within the 79 studies, we found 1,599 different treatment outcomes.

es.quote: The mean odds ratio was 2.41 (with a 95% confidence interval ranging from a low of 1.79 to a high of 3.25).

replication.target_description: Full replication article not acquired through free public routes within acquisition allowance.

notes: Original source is the full author-uploaded OnlineFirst article, with OnlineFirst page numbers; cached text contains frozen excerpts.
